title: Diffuse predictions stabilize and reshape neural code during memory encoding
description: EEG dataset from a visual working memory experiment in which participants judged whether a probe grating was rotated clockwise or counterclockwise relative to a memorized orientation. Color cues either predicted a 90° segment of possible orientations or gave no information about orientation. The dataset supports investigation of how diffuse predictions stabilize and reshape neural codes during memory encoding.
methods_description: Participants performed an orientation memory task with a clockwise/counterclockwise probe judgment. Each memory item was preceded by a central color cue (red, green, or blue). In predictive trials, two colors cued non-overlapping 90° orientation segments, while in non-predictive trials a third color signaled that any orientation was possible.
